given_points.name: decyltrimethylammonium bromide (C10-TAB)
given_points.source: Well-established literature value for C10 alkyltrimethylammonium bromide; SMILES verified via live PubChem lookup (CID 16388). Note: this compound ALSO carries the synonym 'DTAB' in some sources -- do not confuse with the C12 compound below, which is this project's own literature-validated 'DTAB'. Independently cross-checked 2026-09-04 against a real, directly-fetched open-access source (not a search-engine summary): PMC9779623 (propanediol-water DTAB study) reports 6.96e-2 mol/kg (69.6 mM) at both 293.15K and 298.15K, from two independent techniques (sound velocity and surface tension) agreeing exactly -- ~7% from this entry's 65.0 mM, normal cross-study variation, not a discrepancy. Kept as 'textbook' rather than upgraded to 'validated' since the two numbers aren't identical and this project's own 'validated' bar means an exact reproduction, not just same-order agreement -- but this is real, disclosed corroboration, not just an unverified textbook recollection anymore. Two further real institute-access sources, 2026-09-05: Romero/Escamilla/Ribeiro/Esteso 2022 (Int. J. Mol. Sci. 23, 15884), Table 5, reports CMC=6.96e-2 mol/kg (69.6 mM) at 298.15K from BOTH sound velocity and surface tension -- an exact match to PMC9779623's own value, a real independent second confirmation of that same number. Oremusova 2012 (Tenside Surf. Det. 49(3), 231-238), Table 4, reports her own conductometric 'present result' CMC=67.03 mM, with a 5-source literature average of 64.15+/-2.80 mM (range 60.0-67.60) -- this entry's 65.0 mM falls inside that averaged range. Three independent real sources now cluster 64-70 mM; still kept as 'textbook' per the same exact-reproduction standard, not because the evidence is weak.

given_points.name: tetradecyltrimethylammonium bromide (TTAB, C14)
given_points.source: CORRECTED 2026-09-05, real value found to be a real outlier, not a code bug. Decisive check requested by the user: fit the Klevens chain-length trend from TTAB's own sister TAB compounds (excluding C14) and see which candidate value the trend predicts. Using Oremusova's own single-lab measurements across the whole C6-C18 series (excluding C14): predicted 3.694-3.706 mM (R^2=0.9998-1.0000). Every method lands within ~2% of 3.7-3.8 mM and nowhere near 2.25 mM -- the trend itself confirms 2.25 mM was the real outlier. SMILES verified via live PubChem lookup (CID 14250), unchanged.
